description: Whether Ploa holds this app's Android upload key, the key every Android build is signed with before it goes to Google Play: its alias, SHA-256 fingerprint and expiry, and its certificate (public) as PEM. The key itself never leaves Ploa. Pass certificatePath to save the certificate there, for a person to give Play Console when it asks for one (Test and release › App integrity › Upload key › Request upload key reset).

certificatePath.description: Absolute path to save the certificate (.pem) to. Optional.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_android_upload_key_get
title: Read the Android upload key
